events.description: Joey Tribbiani says Lydia is currently pushing the baby out during childbirth and that Lydia can do it.
Joey Tribbiani says Lydia should push right now during childbirth.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani and Lydia are planning to get the figurative ball in a sports-style cheer to motivate Lydia's pushing.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani and Lydia are planning to really move as part of the same sports-style cheer to motivate Lydia's pushing.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani was just starting a sports-style cheer and then stops himself.
